title: Guided Caching & Fallback Briefing Panel (compact)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact briefing panel that surfaces recommended caching and batching configurations alongside automated fallback suggestions. The panel should live as an unobtrusive strip in the Redwood Console right-hand rail and be usable by platform engineers and product owners to quickly adopt safe, cost-aware presets or open the full configurator. Main goals: 1) reduce cognitive load by summarizing tradeoffs (cost / latency / quality / risk) in a single-line card; 2) provide one-click apply for vetted presets with optional canary rollout controls; 3) explain fallback behavior and rollback window clearly; 4) include links to simulator, recent regressions, and audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Compact panel appears in Console -> Models -> <model> right rail and aggregates current workload signals (QPS, p95 latency, recent diffs)
Panel shows three recommended presets: Cost-Saver, Balanced, Latency-First; each preset displays estimated monthly token savings and expected p95 delta
One-click 'Apply Preset' triggers a canary rollout modal with configurable percent and duration; modal links to the rollout audit log
Fallback explanation accordion surfaces: when fallback will trigger, compatible model variants used, and KV-prefetch behavior during fallback
Design includes microcopy for risk bands (none/low/medium/high) and accessible color + iconography for quick scanning
Prototype includes a replay simulator deep link that pre-populates sample traffic for the selected model/preset
Design spec includes states for: empty data, noisy telemetry, error retrieving suggestions, and applied state with rollback CTA
Design is reviewed and signed off by PM (Imani Zhao) and Eng lead (Rafael Ortega) and attached Figma link is provided
tasks: Create compact visual treatment and tokenized microcopy (Ava)
Hook telemetry tokens and compute savings estimate formula with Eng (Rafael)
Prototype canary modal flow in Figma and record micro-interactions (Ava)
Write acceptance criteria for UX engineering handoff and edge states (PM Imani)
Run 3 design reviews with platform SREs and incorporate feedback (Sofia)
